meaning: declared contracts of functions whose bodies this run analysed, checked against those bodies (contract spec C06.4): a declaration is refuted when a counted-user clause of the function's own row is refuted, or the validated summary of the body contradicts a declared custody duty (a refinement inside one duty is not a refutation); a refuted declaration stays in force for its own body, whose row keeps the refutation, and every other call site is held with reason code `contract-refuted-by-body`, which is Unknown, never Pending or Safe; the table is the union of every unit's refutations from a first pass under the loaded contracts, and a second pass applies it to every unit when it is not empty; `held_functions` counts analysed functions with at least one recorded held call, `held_call_sites` the held-call refusals recorded, a lower bound on textual call sites
